revision_reason: Initial plan written from architecture revision 1.

phases.title: First working path
phases.outcome: The command builds with the Go toolchain, passes its tests, and prints the number of non-empty lines in a real text file.

stages.title: Line counting command
stages.outcome: The repository builds, the tests pass, and the command counts non-empty lines in the named file.

tasks.title: Add a -w flag that also prints the word count
tasks.scope: Add a -w flag to the command. With the flag, print the non-empty line count and the number of whitespace-separated words in the named file. Without the flag, keep the current output unchanged. Do not add dependencies.
tasks.output: An updated main.go and tests that cover the -w flag.
acceptance: Running the command with -w prints the non-empty line count and the word count.
Running the command without -w prints only the non-empty line count.
The test command exits with code 0.

requirements.text: The command prints the number of non-empty lines in the named file.
A missing or unreadable file prints a readable error to standard error and exits with code 1.
The -w flag also prints the word count.
